name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Botanist, Callisto, and Algae belong to different colonists.
Lichen goes with none of Eklund, Ceres, or Venus.
Ceres goes with exactly three of Okafor, Geologist, Lumen, and Lichen.
